spans.s:
(इर उ) इरहृषु r. 4th cl. (हृष्यति)
To rejoice, to exult, to be pleased or delighted.
(उ) हृषु r. 1st cl. (हर्षति)
To lie, to affirm falsely.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Astonished, surprised.
2 Pleased, delighted.
3 Exquisitely delighted, having the hair of the body [] erect with pleasure.
4 Disappointed, baulked, deceived.
5 Bent, bowed.
6 Armed, accountred.
E.
हृष to be pleased, aff. क्त, with the augment इट्.

n. (-कं)
Any organ of sense.
E.
हृष to affirm falsely, ईकन् Uṇādi aff., and the radical vowel unchanged.

m. (-शः)
KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU.
E.
हृषीक an organ of sense, and ईश lord.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Pleased, glad, delighted.
2 Laughing, smiling.
3 Having the hair of the body erect with pleasure.
4 Astonished, surprised.
5 Disappointed.
E.
हृष to be pleased, or to affirm falsely, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Well-conditioned, well fed and happy.
E.
हृष्ट, and पुष्ट nourished.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Happy, glad.
E.
हृष्ट pleased, मानस the mind, अण् aff.

mfn. (-मा-मा-म)
Having the hair of the body on end.
E.
हृष्ट delighted, रोमन् the down of the body.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Happy, light-hearted.
E.
हृष्ट, and हृदय the heart.

f. (-ष्टिः)
1 Delight, pleasure, happiness.
2 Pride, arrogance.
E.
हृष to be pleased, aff. क्तिन्.
